name: @dotcraft/sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for DotCraft applications, AppServer wire clients, Hub bootstrap, and external channel modules

scripts.test: npm run build:all && node --test dist/client.test.js dist/serverRequests.test.js dist/dotcraft.test.js dist/hubClient.test.js dist/hubCodexRemote.test.js dist/hubBootstrap.test.js dist/turnReply.test.js dist/transport.test.js dist/protocolBaseline.test.js dist/generatedAppServer.test.js dist/publicApi.test.js
scripts.typecheck:example: npm run build && npm run typecheck:example:built
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @dotcraft/avatar && npm run build --workspace @dotcraft/island && npm run build --workspace @dotcraft/plugin
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:packages
scripts.test:packages: npm run test --workspace @dotcraft/avatar && npm run test --workspace @dotcraft/island && npm run test --workspace @dotcraft/plugin
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:packages
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck --workspace @dotcraft/avatar && npm run typecheck --workspace @dotcraft/island && npm run typecheck --workspace @dotcraft/plugin
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:example:built && npm run typecheck:packages
scripts.pack:verify: npm pack --dry-run && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dotcraft/plugin && node scripts/verify-plugin-consumer.mjs && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dotcraft/avatar && npm pack --dry-run --workspace @dotcraft/island && node scripts/verify-avatar-consumer.mjs
